exposure: Pandemic period (March-May 2020) vs. pre-pandemic period (March-May 2018 and 2019)
cohort: Pregnant women who delivered between March and May in 2018, 2019, and 2020 (n=1660)
finding: The study found a significant reduction in the rate of cesarean deliveries during the first COVID-19 lockdown period in Switzerland (March-May 2020) compared to the same period in the previous two years.
mod_finding: The rate of cesarean delivery was significantly reduced in early 2020 during the first COVID-19 lockdown in Switzerland, compared to the same period in the previous two years.
